items.markdown:
`Fill out your TDAC form entirely for free within 3 days of your arrival date on the Official Thai Immigration Bureau website` . You will need your passport, flight details, and the address of your first hotel. Each traveler must complete a separate form.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=moT-nv0ALhM&t=19) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=moT-nv0ALhM&t=19)[[2]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/visa-general-information?menu=65bb7713d0737318de2bab23)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AiP8cKEIRMw&t=3)

Step-by-Step Filling Guide

1. **Access the Portal:** Go to the Official Thai Immigration Bureau website and click on the "Arrival Card" button. Change the language to English in the top-right corner if needed.[](https://buenos-aires.thaiembassy.org/en/content/how-to-submit-the-thailand-digital-arrival-card-td?page=6895beb7f3ab2f78d76643e3&menu=688b1b8b51b65d3c1f16d613) [[1]](https://buenos-aires.thaiembassy.org/en/content/how-to-submit-the-thailand-digital-arrival-card-td?page=6895beb7f3ab2f78d76643e3&menu=688b1b8b51b65d3c1f16d613)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3m-fkq79Xeg&vl=en&t=4)
2. **Personal Information:** Enter your name, passport number, nationality, date of birth, and occupation *exactly* as they appear on your passport. For "Visa Number", leave it blank if you are entering visa-free or using a visa on arrival.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UCMKjUwbvew&vl=en) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UCMKjUwbvew&vl=en)
3. **Travel Information:** Provide your exact arrival date, country of departure, mode of travel (air, land, or sea), and flight/vehicle number.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fZySOjHuL-s&t=3)
4. **Accommodation Details:** Select your accommodation type (e.g., hotel, friends/family) and provide the province, district, and address of your first place of stay.
5. **Health Declaration:** Fill out the health section by listing any countries you have visited in the two weeks prior to your trip to Thailand.
6. **Submit & Download:** Preview your details, enter a valid email address to receive the confirmation, and submit the form. You will receive a unique QR code via email—save a screenshot of this on your phone to show at immigration.[](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/pZUCzaXvDCQ?vl=en) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/pZUCzaXvDCQ?vl=en)
